facts.fact: The Point reports the pilot launch of an Electronic Medical Records system at Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital, the country's main referral hospital, with MRC Gambia's director of operations saying it is being rolled out to other departments within the hospital; the article carries no date, so its published date is used.

The article states the EMR was developed over years by technicians and staff of the Medical Research Council Unit The Gambia and launched at the hospital under a memorandum of understanding between the two institutions, with the Ministry of Health thanking MRCG for the collaboration; undated in the article, so its published date is used.

systems.platform: software developed in-house by MRC Unit The Gambia
systems.owner: MRC Unit The Gambia with Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital
systems.tiers: pilot at Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital, being rolled out to other departments of the hospital
